board.name: Hawaii Medical Board (DCCA Professional and Vocational Licensing)

ce.categoryRules: 40 credit hours of AMA Category 1, AOA Category 1A, or AAPA Category 1 CME per biennium (random audit).
ce.controlledSubstanceCe: None found for PAs in the sources loaded.
ce.acceptsNccpaCertificationInLieuNote: HRS 453-5.3(k) requires forty credit hours of AMA Category 1, AOA 1A or AAPA Category 1 CME with no certification alternative, and NCCPA certification is separately required for renewal (HAR 16-85-48). Inference from statute text; no board statement either way.

practice.agreementFilingAndRenewal: Each supervising physician submits a signed statement of supervision (form AMD-03) to the board; supervising physician must also be renewed before the PA licence renews; board notified within ten days of severance of supervision or employment. PA and supervising physician keep written medical record review guidelines in the office; record review percentages set by statute for PAs with under one year of practice.
practice.notes: HAR 16-85-49 (last amended 12/22/97, current DCCA compilation) still says a physician may supervise no more than two PAs, PAs may not prescribe Schedule II (inpatient hospital orders excepted), and records are reviewed within seven working days; HRS 453-5.3 was amended in 2019 and 2022 and now sets the record review schedule, so the 1997 limits may be superseded. Show the statute's record review rules; treat the 1997 limits as not yet verified.

prescribing.separateAuthorityRegistration: Prescribing is delegated by the supervising physician; PA delegated Schedule III to V must register with DEA; Hawaii controlled substance registration under HRS 329-32 applies to every person who prescribes controlled substances in the State.

board.name: Hawaii Board of Nursing (DCCA Professional and Vocational Licensing)

rn.ceNote: Continuing competency: complete one learning activity option per biennium; 30 contact hours of CE is one option, national certification or recertification related to the practice role is another.

aprn.title: APRN (Advanced Practice Registered Nurse) licence, with optional prescriptive authority
aprn.separateLicenceOrCertificate: separate APRN licence (requires current Hawaii RN licence); prescriptive authority is a separate privilege renewed with it
aprn.ceNote: 30 contact hours applies to APRNs renewing prescriptive authority (22 practice specialty + 8 pharmacology); continuing education used for national recertification in the biennium may be accepted in lieu. APRNs without prescriptive authority meet RN continuing competency (national certification qualifies).
aprn.nationalCertificationNote: Conditional for the APRN licence: proof of current certification at renewal is required only from APRNs licensed initially by national certification (no graduate degree in a board recognized specialty) (HAR 16-89-87(a)(1); board APRN renewal page); APRNs licensed before October 1, 2009 on a master's degree may renew (HRS 457-8.5(b)). Every APRN renewing prescriptive authority must hold current national certification (HAR 16-89-123(a)(1)).

prescribing.separateAuthorityRegistration: Yes: APRN prescriptive authority granted by the Board of Nursing, expires June 30 of odd-numbered years with the APRN licence; Hawaii controlled substance registration (HRS 329-32) plus DEA for controlled substances.
prescribing.pharmacologyCeForPrescribers: 8 of 30 contact hours each biennium in pharmacology including pharmacotherapeutics

practice.agreementFilingAndRenewal: No physician collaboration or supervision agreement found in HRS 457; APRN consults or refers as appropriate.

unverified: Hawaii Nurse Licensure Compact: no Hawaii primary source loaded; secondary search results (2026) say Hawaii has introduced but not enacted the NLC. nlcCompactMember=false is verified:false.
Practice authority 'full': HRS 457-2.7 and 457-8.6 contain no physician collaboration or supervision requirement; the word 'full' is a classification, not statutory.

HAR 16-85 Subchapter 6 PA rules (1997): two-PA limit, no Schedule II outside inpatient orders, seven working day chart review may be superseded by 2019/2022 amendments to HRS 453-5.3. Not shown as current requirements.
PA acceptsNccpaCertificationInLieu=false is an inference from HRS 453-5.3(k); no board statement either way.

No Hawaii topic mandates (opioid, pain, implicit bias, etc.) for PAs, RNs or APRNs were found in HRS 453, HRS 457, HAR 16-85, HAR 16-89 or the board renewal pages; absence is not affirmatively stated by a primary source.
Federal DEA MATE 8 hour one-time training is federal, not Hawaii law; not loaded in this verification.

corrections: HAR 16-89: researcher used the superseded 2013 compilation (files.hawaii.gov). The board's statute and rules page links the September 6, 2018 compilation (HAR-89-C.pdf), where 16-89-87 is 'Renewal of APRN license' (not 'recognition'). Updated URLs and the renewal quote.

Prescriptive authority CE: current rule (2018) itself states the 22 specialty + 8 pharmacology split and an attestation under oath with random audit (60 days to document); researcher sourced the split only from the FAQ.

np.aprn.nationalCertificationRequired: researcher stated it as unconditional. At APRN licence renewal only certification-based licensees must show certification (HAR 16-89-87(a)(1), board APRN page), with pre-2009 master's-based licensees grandfathered (HRS 457-8.5(b)); certification is required for everyone renewing prescriptive authority (16-89-123(a)(1)).

pa.ce.acceptsNccpaCertificationInLieu: null -> false (inference from HRS 453-5.3(k), which requires 40 Category 1 hours with no alternative; NCCPA is a separate renewal condition under HAR 16-85-48). Marked as inference.
Added the statutory medical record review schedule (HRS 453-5.3(g)(2)) as a fact; researcher mentioned it only in prose.
